我方定稿: 亲爱的母亲：谢谢你的来信。能收到你的消息，我总是很高兴。你的英文很好，比我还好。很抱歉我一直没能做个好儿子，也不能在你身边照顾你，但你知道我回不了家。回去只会带来麻烦，也会勾起我们俩不愉快的回忆。罗曼很好。他正在做美国梦，不过这梦多半只在他脑子里，跟所有梦一样。
corpus英文: Dear mother, thank you for your e mail. I am always happy to hear from you. Your English is good. Better than mine. I am sorry I have not been much of a good son to you, and that I am not there to take care of you, but you know I cannot come back home. It would bring trouble, and unhappy memories for us both. Roman is well. He is living the American dream, mostly in his head, like all dream.
